question: Who among the following singers became the first Indian folk artist to attend the Cannes Film Festival 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mame Khan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mame Khan** became the** first **Indian folk artist to attend the** Cannes Film Festival 2022.**
 
• He is a renowned **Rajasthani folk singer** who belongs to the **Manganiyar community.**
 
• Mame Khan has been associated with the music industry for over** 20 years** and has performed on various national and international platforms.
 
• He has also collaborated with several **Bollywood music composers** and has lent his voice to many popular songs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian singer-songwriter-actor **Gurdas Maan **is primarily known for his work in Punjabi movies and music.

 
 
• In** 1980, **he became well-known across the country because of the song **"Dil Da Mamla Hai". **
 
 
 
• Indian singer, author, composer, and record producer **Daler Mehndi.**
 
 
• He has contributed to the global popularity of **Bhangra.**
 
 
 
• As a practitioner of the ancient performing art form known as** pandavani, Teejan Bai** narrates stories from the **Mahabharata **while accompanied by music.
 
 
• Teejan Bai is a folk artist from **Chhattisgarh, **who has received several awards for her contribution to the field of folk music.
